 Harit strikes inside first minute as Marseille climb to sixth 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Marseille beat Toulouse 2-0 at the Vélodrome on Sunday to rise from eighth to sixth in Ligue 1.
 Amine Harit fired in from outside the box in the first minute after Amine Gouiri 's lay-off. Gouiri then doubled the lead (25.) with a neat finish from Igor Paixão's headed pass.
 OneFootball Videos
 Jeffrey de Lange was outstanding, making six saves to keep Toulouse at bay across both halves, including sharp stops from Jacen Russell-Rowe and Thomas Jørgensen.
 An early injury forced Ulisses Alexandre Garcia on for Emerson, and Harit later departed after a knock, but Les Olympiens stayed compact and dangerous on transitions. Paixão also struck the post after the restart.
 A Casper Tengstedt strike was ruled out after a VAR review for offside (68.), ending Toulouse's hopes of a late swing.
 Toulouse saw plenty of the ball, finishing with 56.4% possession and 14 attempts, seven on target. Les Olympiens registered 13 attempts, three on target, and managed the closing stages calmly.
 Next, Les Olympiens visit Bayer Leverkusen in the Europa League. Toulouse host Strasbourg in Ligue 1.
